title: Speed up the nightly test gate
objective: Make the gate settings correct and stable.
situation: An agent is asked to raise the nightly release gate from serial execution to four parallel test workers so it finishes faster.

evidence.text: The same worker-count setting changed four times in one day: sped up, made serial, set to zero, restored to four. No change recorded a reason.
The nightly gate runs unattended; a flaky failure there delays a release. Pull-request runs have a human waiting.
Current settings: nightly gate 4 workers; pull-request run 0 workers (serial).
Recent nightly failures show simulator contention errors that did not reproduce serially.

question: Choose the single best next action for the agent responsible, cite the evidence ids your decision depends on, and state whether the stated objective is satisfied now.
